title: Machine Learning Prediction of Porosity in Low-Pressure-Cast AlSi7Mg Alloy with Varying Recycled Aluminum Content.
summary: PMC full text Methods/Results: 200 measured low-pressure-cast alloy observations; porosity rises 0.160% to 6.111% across 50–95 wt.% scrap without Mn correction; second-order regression with interactions achieves grouped leave-one-scrap-level-out R² .991, RMSE .1691, MAE .1508. Training-only tuning and holdout separation are described. The result is reported in the Materials. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
